notes.title: V1.02.001 Patch
notes.notes: Beautiful additional background added, floor-level platforms are easier to discern from lava, added an immersive visual effect (cinders on the wind), fixed a bug in which levelsets could stop loading, and fixed dead-player-running scenario. Improved support for OSX. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42822496/cc3c8e9de4f4f4e5907206bad7eb028f4b7f622d.png
